top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 arc is complete, replicated and mature, from proglucagon processing and the active peptide through glucose-dependent insulin secretion to outcome-proven drugs. P002 (Drucker, Holst, Knudsen) names the physiology and the inventive step, albumin binding and DPP-4 resistance, that turned a peptide with a half-life of minutes into a once-weekly medicine, and it avoids ruling on the contested Mojsov and Habener priority. P001 is a close second and acceptable on a discovery-only reading; any GLP-1 prize is far better than no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; the documented co-authorship with Rickard Sandberg and the 2016 spatial transcriptomics paper do not involve any credited name on the slate
